title: Demystifying Hateful Content: Leveraging Large Multimodal Models for Hateful Meme Detection with Explainable Decisions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating hateful meme detection and interpretation on the MAMI (Multimedia Automatic Misogyny Identification) dataset and the FHM-FG dataset.
Evaluating the classification of hateful memes using the FHM-FG dataset and conducting explainability case studies (using LIME) on memes containing racial stereotypes.
Evaluating the classification of hateful memes using the FHM-FG dataset, which includes a distinct category for religious-based incitement to hatred.
Evaluating the classification of hateful memes using the FHM-FG dataset, which includes a distinct category for nationality-based incitement to hatred.
Evaluating the classification of hateful memes using the FHM-FG dataset and conducting explainability case studies (using LIME) on memes targeting individuals with mental disorders.
